$comment: Portable MCP server definitions for the frontend design/animation workflow. Merge these into your agent's MCP config (opencode.jsonc, .cursor/mcp.json, claude .mcp.json, etc.). Secrets are referenced via environment variables and must NOT be committed.

shadcn.comment: Universal registry client. Reads registries from react/components.json. Serves React registries: Magic UI, Aceternity, Kokonut, Skiper, ReactBits, OriginUI, Cult UI.

shadcn-svelte.comment: Svelte-native registry client. Reads registries from svelte/components.json. Serves the Bhide Svelte registries: sv-animations, sv-table, sv-blocks, sv-efferd, sv-matrix, sveltebits.

21st.comment: Generative UI (10k+ React components), search, logos, themes. Get an API key at https://21st.dev/mcp and export X_21ST_API_KEY.

magicui.comment: Magic UI animation components (marquee, bento grid, animated beams, text effects).

motion.comment: Motion.dev AI Kit: CSS spring generation, animation docs, 430+ examples, MotionScore performance audits.
